mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two LoanApplications with PendingReview status to share the same customer, directly violating FR-005 and the uniqueness invariant the assertion checks.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OnePendingViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.status = PendingReview and a2.status = PendingReview and a1.customer = a2.customer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits two distinct Decision rows referencing the same application, modelling a failed concurrency guard (FR-012, SC-005). The ConcurrencySafety and FR_011 assertions should then find a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoDecisionsViolation { some disj d1, d2: Decision | d1.application = d2.application }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only fact allows an ApplicationEvent with eventType EvtApproved to exist on an application that is still in PendingReview, simulating a forged or out-of-order audit entry — exactly what the AppendOnly assertion is meant to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some e: ApplicationEvent | e.eventType = EvtApproved and e.application.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an Operation where a customer accesses another customer's application and receives Forbidden instead of NotFound, leaking existence information in violation of FR-013 and SC-004.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpGetApplicationByRef and op.caller.role = CustomerRole and some op.targetApp and op.targetApp.customer != op.caller and op.outcome = Forbidden }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Decision to be recorded by a user with CustomerRole as decidedBy, breaking the bank-staff-only restriction from FR-015. LeastPrivilege and FR_015 assertions should then fail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CustomerDeciderViolation { some d: Decision | d.decidedBy.role = CustomerRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an EvtApproved audit event whose actor does not match the staff member in the corresponding Decision row — a misattribution that violates FR-016's requirement that the audit record names who decided.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some e: ApplicationEvent | e.eventType = EvtApproved and (all d: Decision | d.application = e.application implies d.decidedBy != e.actor) }
